intro.text:
AI-Powered Content Suggestions

This page demonstrates the AI-enhanced text field component that can automatically generate intelligent suggestions for titles, summaries, and meta descriptions.

The AI suggestion feature integrates with multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Ollama for local models.

features.text:
Key Features

  • Smart Title Generation: Create compelling page titles based on content
  • Automatic Summaries: Generate concise summaries from page text
  • SEO Meta Descriptions: Craft optimized meta descriptions for search engines
  • Multi-Provider Support: Works with OpenAI GPT-4, Claude, Azure, and local Ollama models
  • Context-Aware: Analyzes all page content or specific fields to generate relevant suggestions
  • User-Friendly Interface: Simple click-to-generate button with visual feedback

howItWorks.text:
How It Works

  1. Edit a Page: Open any page in the CMS editor
  2. Find AI-Enhanced Fields: Look for text fields with the ✨ sparkle icon and "AI Suggest" button
  3. Generate Suggestions: Click the "AI Suggest" button to generate intelligent content
  4. Review and Edit: The AI-generated suggestion appears in the field for you to review and modify
  5. Save: Save your page with the AI-enhanced content

useCases.text:
Use Cases

Content Marketing

Quickly generate compelling titles and descriptions for blog posts, landing pages, and marketing content. Save hours of copywriting time while maintaining consistent quality.

SEO Optimization

Create search-engine-optimized meta descriptions that accurately reflect page content. Improve click-through rates with AI-generated meta tags.

Multilingual Sites

Generate content in multiple languages by configuring different AI models with language-specific prompts.

Content Teams

Accelerate content production workflows by automating repetitive writing tasks. Let writers focus on creating unique, high-value content.

configuration.text:
Configuration

The AI suggestion feature requires configuration of at least one AI service provider:

OpenAI Configuration

org.apache.sling.cms.ai.internal.OpenAiTextService
  apiKey=your-openai-api-key
  model=gpt-4
  temperature=0.7

Azure OpenAI Configuration

org.apache.sling.cms.ai.internal.AzureOpenAiTextService
  endpoint=https://your-resource.openai.azure.com/
  apiKey=your-azure-key
  deployment=gpt-4

Anthropic Claude Configuration

org.apache.sling.cms.ai.internal.AnthropicTextService
  apiKey=your-anthropic-api-key
  model=claude-3-opus-20240229

Ollama (Local) Configuration

org.apache.sling.cms.ai.internal.OllamaTextService
  endpoint=http://localhost:11434
  model=llama2

Configure these via OSGi Config Admin at /system/console/configMgr

technical.text:
Technical Details

Component Path

/libs/sling-cms/components/editor/fields/text-ai

Servlet Endpoint

POST /bin/cms/ai/suggest.json

Supported AI Types

  • title - Generate page titles (50-70 characters)
  • summary - Generate content summaries (150-200 words)
  • metaDescription - Generate SEO meta descriptions (150-160 characters)

Content Source Options

  • Specific field name (e.g., pageContent)
  • Empty/null - Analyzes all form text inputs and textareas

Example Field Configuration

{
  "component": "/libs/sling-cms/components/editor/fields/text-ai",
  "label": "Page Title",
  "name": "jcr:title",
  "type": "text",
  "aiSuggestionType": "title",
  "contentSource": "pageContent",
  "required": true,
  "placeholder": "Enter page title or click AI Suggest"
}

examples.text:
Example Scenarios

Blog Post Title

Content: "Apache Sling is a web framework that uses a Java Content Repository to store and manage content. It provides a RESTful web application framework built on top of Apache Jackrabbit."

AI-Generated Title: "Apache Sling: RESTful Web Framework Built on Java Content Repository"

Product Page Summary

Content: Full product description with features, specifications, and benefits

AI-Generated Summary: "A comprehensive enterprise content management solution offering scalable architecture, flexible content modeling, and seamless integration with modern web technologies. Ideal for organizations seeking robust digital experience platforms."

Meta Description

Content: Long-form article about web development best practices

AI-Generated Meta: "Discover proven web development best practices for 2026. Learn modern frameworks, performance optimization, and security essentials in this comprehensive guide."

bestPractices.text:
Best Practices

  • Review AI Output: Always review and edit AI-generated content to ensure accuracy and brand voice
  • Provide Context: More content yields better suggestions - fill in main content before generating titles
  • Configure Quality Models: Use GPT-4 or Claude 3 Opus for best results over smaller models
  • Set Temperature: Lower temperature (0.5-0.7) for consistent, factual output; higher (0.8-1.0) for creative content
  • Specific Content Sources: Target specific rich text fields rather than all form inputs for more relevant suggestions
  • Test Different Providers: Different AI models excel at different tasks - experiment to find the best fit
  • Monitor Costs: API-based providers charge per token - monitor usage in production environments
  • Local Models: Consider Ollama with llama2/mistral for cost-free suggestions on localhost
